Long Watch.name: Long Watch
Long Watch.description: The user takes a firing position over a doorway, street or rooftop and holds it. Until the user moves, is attacked or runs out of rounds, each opponent who enters that area, draws a weapon there or attacks an ally under the user's watch is shot before they can finish the action: the action fails and the opponent takes piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds). Stamina: heavy.
